name: Ancient Abyssal Wurm
tactics: An ancient abyssal wurm toys with its prey before unleashing its breath attack. The wurm’s sheer, scaly size and immense teeth are enough to overwhelm opponents with fear. Each time the wurm unleashes its breath weapon, it disappears, reforming in a more advantageous position. If seriously wounded, the wurm might retreat through a gate it guards.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Pit of Despair
traits.details: Any enemy within the aura that misses with an attack takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against the abyssal wurm until the end of the enemy’s next turn.

traits.name: All-Around Vision
traits.details: Enemies can’t gain combat advantage by flanking the abyssal wurm.

traits.name: Double Actions
traits.details: At the start of combat, the abyssal wurm makes two initiative checks. Each check corresponds to one of its heads, and the wurm takes a turn on both initiative counts. It has a full set of actions on each of its turns, and its ability to take an immediate action refreshes on each turn.

traits.name: Dual Brain
traits.details: At the end of each of its turns, the abyssal wurm saves against effects that include the dazed or stunned condition and against charm effects.

auras.name: Pit of Despair
auras.details: Any enemy within the aura that misses with an attack takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls against the abyssal wurm until the end of the enemy’s next turn.

hit.description: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, and the target takes a -4 penalty to AC (save ends).

effect.description: The wurm dissolves into a torrent of elements and flows with its breath weapon. The wurm moves instantaneously from its current location to a square adjacent to the area of the blast.

hit.description: The target is dominated until the end of its next turn. For its action, the dominated creature uses one of its at-will powers of the wurm’s choice against itself.

effect.description: The wurm’s breath weapon recharges, and the wurm uses it.

powers.name: Variable Resistance
powers.trigger: The wurm takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage.

effect.description: The wurm gains resist 20 to the triggering damage type until the end of the encounter or until it uses variable resistance again.
